label: CPS-LAI-01 — OPERATIONAL EMULATOR
info: Operational substitute for CPS-LAI-01; disabled by default and started only by a scenario Inject. Publishes to the principal loopback broker at 127.0.0.1:1883 after the operator verifies that cpslai1/# has no other active producer. No OPC UA, PLC, email, or PPU command path.

name: OPERATIONAL EMULATOR — manual scenario controls
info: Before enabling this tab, verify that no other producer is active on cpslai1/#. Use a scenario button to start/restart and STOP to stop. Enabling/deploying does not start publication because the clock has once=false and the active flag is set only by a scenario button.
